sourceNotes.claim: Jan Bobek 2023 cites Baumgartl tables based on Rechlin: 523 km/h Bf109F4 combat speed, 540 km/h emergency sea-level speed; H.H. Vogt also 540. Exact source-test airframe/conditions not independently inspected.
Rechlin 10 December 1941 F4 vs Fw190A2 combat-weight flight comparison, original page 2 pictured; author notes restricted DB601E emergency rating in 1941.
Attribution: 109F4 climbs 1000 to 5000m in 4 min vs Fw190A2 4 min 50 sec. This datum is a provisional withheld clue, not a vetted flight-test target.
Game designer power modes are combat 30-min and emergency 1-min, prop and engine maps heuristic; not independently measured turn performance.
